scope: Two shared and two unique twelve-resident public appearance-library cycles in isolated headless Chromium, not full editor/game simulation.
findings: All public cache and borrowed-provider ownership drains; DOM returns to baseline.
Timestamp-bracketed native dumps show renderer private footprint 19547136 bytes baseline, 724536320 bytes active and 168119296 bytes released.
Active canvas root reports 233310792 bytes; it is omitted from the released dump. An omitted allocator is not interpreted as measured zero.
Released renderer partition allocation remains 114327552 bytes. Native buffer ownership and longer-run bounds remain unresolved.
Process RSS, private footprint and JavaScript heap are different measurements and must not be substituted for each other.
